sections.heading: Life and writing
paragraphs: Sanghamitra Devi writes under the pen name Sami. She is a writer and poet from Odisha, India.

Her writing brings scientific ideas into conversation with questions of life and human emotion. Through metaphor, she explores love, erotica, repentance and sustainability, alongside social criticism and change.
Her work appears in international magazines, newspaper editorials and poetry galleries. She also shares her writing on Writco, Mirakee and YourQuote, and through her page Inevitable Solitude.
